cannot sell to children or grandchildren if the other children or grandchildren do not consent to the sale.
+- If consent cannot be given or is refused, it may be judicially supplied.
+- A sale made without the required consent is voidable.
+- Annulment may be requested by the children or grandchildren who did not give consent.
+- The annulment request must be made within one year from knowledge of the contract's conclusion, or from the end of incapacity if the non-consenting child or grandchild is incapable.
+- The prohibition does not cover a dação em cumprimento made by the ascendant.
+
+DR Lexionário summary: the sale by parents or grandparents to children or grandchildren, where there is more than one child or grandchild, requires consent of the other children or grandchildren; the non-consented sale is voidable by those who did not consent within the stated one-year period.
